title: Korean Face Solo #01 (한국 · 20대 · 발랄한 · 메이크업 혼례(연지곤지) 4단계 · 아주 강함 · 피어싱 P15+쥬얼리 · 렌즈 오드아이 크림슨 레드(방사형 무늬)|앰버(고양이눈))
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the base of her neck and the tops of her collarbones, the frame cutting off there. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Korean woman — Korean fresh natural beauty luminous milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and smooth dewy skin, mid 20s, hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most dramatic hourglass ratio ever, simultaneously maximum enormous bust AND maximum enormous hips both flaring to absolute impossible extremes while the waist is cinched to impossible minimum, sleek black long hair with a centre part. Real pores and fine skin grain on her skin, a soft sheen of natural oils, large eyes with bright real catchlights, full lips, a stark white painted face, large saturated crimson yeonji circles covering the apples of both cheeks, a large bold red gonji circle on the forehead, thin sharp black crescent brows, tiny deep-red painted lips, odd-eyed with two clearly different lenses: her left eye has an intense crimson-red coloured contact lens with a radiating sunburst iris pattern, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, and her right eye has a glowing amber-gold coloured contact lens with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, the two eye colours both bright and clearly different from each other, eyes crinkling with joy, cheeks lifted high by a wide open laughing smile showing white teeth, a lively, cheerful, radiant expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light 

Piercings: On each ear four pieces: a big copper bar in the lobe, a smaller copper ring above it, a thick copper bar and a small copper stud at the top; a small copper ring passes through each nostril; a thin copper bar passes through the outer end of each eyebrow; a copper hoop passes through the lower lip's edge; a copper labret stud sits beneath the lower lip with a small copper ring below it. Each piece carries small rubies set into the metal. All jewelry is real copper, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Jewelry: besides the piercings she wears a single piece of mixed-metal necklaces and chains resting on her neck and collarbones, and a single piece of mixed-metal hair ornaments set in her hair, all of it real, without covering her eyes, her face or her piercings.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
